policy: Reviewed first-party issuer/fiscal-period/full-public-content identity plus established publication instant, or completed call and full public content before next UTC midnight. Report date, planned start, fetch time and now-online are insufficient.

denominator.preview: Historical proposal only; no corrected records admitted.

proposed_guard_scope: Stop automatic AlphaVantageTranscriptAdapter materialization until an authorized complete-public-content proof interface exists. No new provenance interface/policy is invented by this local guard.
call_chain: evolution_control._build_evidence_resolver configured AlphaVantageClient -> AlphaVantageTranscriptAdapter; disabled-external descriptor also instantiates this adapter with None; missing-key branch uses UnavailableProviderAdapter.
EvidenceResolver.resolve -> local lookup first -> authorized adapter -> budget.reserve -> adapter.acquire -> store.append -> local reread.
Adapter currently fetches earnings, makes a retrieved-at raw response, maps fiscal quarters with reportedDate+1 UTC, then stamps transcript published/available from that derived clock.
AlphaVantageClient.earnings_call_transcript returns provider JSON only; preserve raw client/cache capabilities and do not conflate fetch success with historical admission.
required_local_controls: Direct adapter acquire for all three transcript aliases must raise AcquisitionFailure(HISTORICAL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE) before identity/earnings/transcript/event-client access; no returned raw response or transcript.

Configured native factory/resolver with empty synthetic store must expose historical unavailability and yield typed gap, not provider_no_data/provider_error/resolved; client method counters remain zero and store unchanged.
Preserve authorization precedence: disabled external policy stays external_not_authorized; no permission bypass.

can_acquire false and acquisition_unavailability_reason historical_data_unavailable for configured proofless adapter if adopting existing available=False descriptor. Resolver budget reservation is a separate existing behavior, not an HTTP request.

Already supplied local eligible synthetic transcript still resolves by local lookup without acquisition; future available_at remains excluded. This is compatibility, not a proof that original26 are now qualified.
Other source families in the same resolver continue to resolve; transcript gap does not imply economic absence or block ordinary SEC/financial/market inputs.
Provider quarter echo, reportedDate, scheduled meeting metadata, current retrieval or arbitrary ad-hoc proof keys cannot bypass the guard.
Raw provider client/cache behavior and all original transcript/provider records remain byte-identical; completed old stages are not migrated or resumed.
why_old_tests_missed: test_transcript_adapter_maps_fiscal_quarters_and_excludes_future_reports asserts reportedDate+1 directly and considers one management remark adequate. It tests fiscal routing/provider echo and the old clock, not actual completion/full-public-content proof. Factory tests assert descriptors/client error-detector wiring without that semantic premise.

remaining_surfaces.meaning: Separate Finnhub DocumentRecord producer stamps list timestamp or fallback calendar quarter-end directly as published_date=available_date/complete body; not fixed by RawInfo adapter guard and must not be claimed compliant if reused.
Current transcript references count inventory/missing capability; no same reportedDate RawInfo materializer found.
Guard does not retrospectively quarantine invalid old timestamps or admit replacements. Keep original26 pending and successor reviewed source exclusions explicit.

reviewer_execution: Only source/spec/test JSON/text/hash reads; no native helper, model, network, labels, store constructor/append, stage or business execution.
limits: This freezes expected local production fail-closed behavior, not transcript proof success, whole F2/MVP readiness or a generalized archival proof interface.
